name: having_on_aggregate
query: SELECT account, count(*) AS n, sum(number) AS total WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:Food' GROUP BY account HAVING count(*) > 20 ORDER BY account
notes: HAVING is part of the GROUP BY clause: GROUP BY ... [HAVING expr] [ORDER BY ...] [PIVOT BY ...] [LIMIT n]. It keeps the groups whose HAVING value is true. The aggregate may also be a target.
